full_prompt_en: A classical oil painting presents a seated young woman in a deep red dress against a shadowed green-black background. The softly varied backdrop is darkest on the left, while a muted olive fold curves downward behind her right shoulder. Near the upper centre, her dark, loosely gathered hair forms a rounded mass of small curls around her head. Her pale face turns toward the left in three-quarter profile, with closed lips, a straight nose and a quiet, serious gaze. One hand supports the side of her jaw; the raised forearm descends diagonally to an elbow resting on a rounded, dark upholstered chair arm at the lower left. Her other forearm crosses horizontally in front of her body, ending in a relaxed hand on the left above her skirt. Both forearms are bare below gathered sleeves. The crimson gown has a low V-shaped neckline, a close-fitting bodice and folds bunched around the elbows. Across the lower half, the full skirt spreads over her lap and descends beyond the frame, with broad brick-red highlights separated by deep wine-coloured creases. Her feet and the chair legs are outside the picture. Soft warm light from the upper left illuminates her forehead, cheek, neck and exposed arms, leaving gentle shadows beneath her jaw and along the right side of her clothing. Smooth transitions model the skin, while broader visible strokes shape the fabric and dark surroundings. The overall composition balances a softly illuminated face and angular arm gesture above a wide red skirt, producing a restrained, contemplative harmony of warm flesh, crimson and deep olive shadow.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅古典油画描绘一位身穿深红连衣裙的年轻女性，坐在幽暗的绿黑色背景前。背景色调柔和变化，左侧最暗，右肩后方有一处暗橄榄色褶痕向下弯曲。上方中央附近，深色头发松松地拢起，小卷发围着头部形成圆润体量。浅色面容以四分之三侧面转向左方，嘴唇闭合，鼻梁平直，目光安静严肃。一只手托住下颌侧面，抬起的前臂斜向下延伸，肘部支在左下方圆拢的深色软椅扶手上。另一只前臂从身前横过，放松的手落在裙子上方的左侧。两条前臂在收拢袖口下裸露。绯红连衣裙有低V形领口、贴身衣身，肘边衣袖褶皱聚拢。下半部宽大的裙摆铺在膝上并延伸出画外，宽阔砖红亮面被深酒红衣褶分开。双脚和椅腿都在画外。左上方柔和暖光照亮额头、脸颊、颈部及裸露手臂，在下颌下方和衣物右侧留下温和阴影。皮肤以平滑过渡塑形，较宽的可见笔触刻画织物与深色环境。整体构图以柔亮面容和折角手臂姿态平衡下方宽阔红裙，让温暖肤色、绯红和深橄榄色阴影形成克制而沉思的和谐。
style_prompt_en: The oil-paint treatment builds form through gradual value transitions, with soft edges around illuminated areas and darker contours merging into the background. Deep umber, near-black and muted olive establish a broad shadow field, while restrained warm reds and pale highlights create focused tonal contrast. Highlights remain broad and gentle rather than glossy, and shadows preserve subtle brown and green undertones. Brushwork shifts from fine blending across small areas to wider strokes describing larger masses, keeping the surface cohesive. The composition favours concentrated illumination against quiet negative space, producing a calm, low-key visual balance.
style_prompt_zh: 油画通过渐进的明度过渡塑造形体，受光处边缘柔和，较暗轮廓则融入背景。深赭、近黑与低饱和橄榄色构成大面积阴影，少量暖红与浅亮色调形成集中的明暗对照。高光宽缓而不显光滑闪耀，阴影中保留细微棕绿底色。笔触从小范围的细致晕染转为表现大色块的宽笔，令表面保持连贯。构图让光线集中在局部，并与安静留白形成平衡，整体视觉沉静而低调。
theme_en: A seated young woman in a deep red dress rests one hand beside her cheek and looks left against a shadowed background.
theme_zh: 一位身穿深红色长裙的年轻女性坐着，一只手靠在面颊旁，目光望向左侧，身后是幽暗背景。
name: 暗底柔光古典油画
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
